areas.hide_immunities: My build deals — hide areas with these immunities
areas.th_map_size_title: Map chunk size and estimated total tiles
areas.how_calculated_body: Area levels are Hell difficulty values. Champions spawn at area level +2 and uniques at +3. Density is a relative signal derived from monster spawn weights — higher is denser, but it is not an exact monster count. Map size is estimated from layout data when available. Super chest presence is detected from object and layout files; actual super chest loot depends on the game's treasure class routing.
